operationalLimits: No global distributed rollback. Subcourses, assignments and map are separate stages; durable resumption is the supported alternative.
Idempotence binds one operation UUID to its owner/course/payload. Intentionally starting a new operation without entity IDs can create duplicates.
Stopping is explicit and does not undo committed creations, edits or deletions.
Per-assignment baseline guards unfinished canonical operation recovery; it is not global optimistic locking for all independent task-edit endpoints.
Course creation counts after a partially completed cross-service attempt may reflect the final ensure call; reserved course IDs remain discoverable.
Journal stores sensitive authoring payloads under editor access. Downloadable audit is allowlisted metadata, not raw payload. UUIDs can still be private.
No automatic retention/purge policy. Last-30 UI history does not mean database expiry. Receipt purging must not break replay.
Unrelated isolated SignalR timeout from the report is not diagnosed or claimed fixed.
